-- https://salsa.debian.org/benchmarksgame-team/benchmarksgame/
-- contributed by Bryan O'Sullivan
-- modified by Eugene Kirpichov: pidgits only generates

import System.Environment

pidgits n = (1,9) % (0 # (1,0,1)) where
 (i,k)%(d:ds')
  | i <= n = putStr (show d ++
               (if k<=0 then "\t:" ++ show i ++ "\n" else "")) >> (j,m)%ds'
  | True = if k<9 then putStrLn (replicate k ' ' ++ "\t:" ++ show n)
           else putStr ""
  where j = i + 1; m = if k<=0 then 9 else k - 1
 j # s | n>a || q/=r = k # t
       | True = q : k # (n*10,(a-(q*d))*10,d) -- inline eliminateDigit
  where k = j+1; t@(n,a,d)=k&s; q=3$t; r=4$t -- two calls to extractDigit
 c$(n,a,d) = (c*n+a)`div`d -- extractDigit
 j&(n,a,d) = (n*j,(a+n*2)*y,d*y) where y=(j*2+1) -- nextDigit

main = pidgits.read.head =<< getArgs

    pf: platform "https://github.com/roc-lang/basic-cli/releases/download/0.20.0/X73hGh05nNTkDHU06FHC0YfFaQB1pimX7gncRcao5mU.tar.br",

import pf.Stdout
import pf.Arg exposing [Arg]
argument : List Arg -> U64
argument = |args|
    arg = (List.get(args, 1) |> Result.map_ok(Arg.display)) ?? "0"
    Str.to_u64(arg) ?? 0
get = |items, index|
    when List.get(items,index) is
        Ok(value) -> value
        Err(_) -> crash("index out of bounds")
Big : {negative : Bool, digits : List U64}

base = 4294967296u64
trim_digits = |digits|
    if List.is_empty(digits) then digits else
        if get(digits,List.len(digits)-1) == 0 then trim_digits(List.drop_last(digits,1)) else digits
big : Bool, List U64 -> Big
big = |negative, digits|
    normalized = trim_digits(digits)
    {negative:negative && !List.is_empty(normalized),digits:normalized}
natural = |value|
    if value == 0 then big(Bool.false,[]) else
        if value < base then big(Bool.false,[value]) else big(Bool.false,[value%base,value//base])
compare_digits = |a,b,remaining|
    if remaining == 0 then EQ else
        index = remaining-1
        order = Num.compare(get(a,index),get(b,index))
        if order == EQ then compare_digits(a,b,index) else order
compare_abs = |a,b|
    order = Num.compare(List.len(a),List.len(b))
    if order == EQ then compare_digits(a,b,List.len(a)) else order
add_digits = |a,b,index,carry,output|
    length = Num.max(List.len(a),List.len(b))
    if index >= length then
        if carry == 0 then output else List.append(output,carry)
    else
        av = List.get(a,index) ?? 0
        bv = List.get(b,index) ?? 0
        sum = av+bv+carry
        add_digits(a,b,index+1,sum//base,List.append(output,sum%base))
add_abs = |a,b| add_digits(a,b,0,0,List.with_capacity(Num.max(List.len(a),List.len(b))+1))
subtract_digits = |a,b,index,borrow,output|
    if index >= List.len(a) then trim_digits(output) else
        av = get(a,index)
        bv = (List.get(b,index) ?? 0)+borrow
        digit = if av < bv then av+base-bv else av-bv
        next_borrow = if av < bv then 1u64 else 0u64
        subtract_digits(a,b,index+1,next_borrow,List.append(output,digit))
subtract_abs = |a,b| subtract_digits(a,b,0,0,List.with_capacity(List.len(a)))
big_add : Big, Big -> Big
big_add = |a,b|
    if a.negative == b.negative then big(a.negative,add_abs(a.digits,b.digits)) else
        when compare_abs(a.digits,b.digits) is
            LT -> big(b.negative,subtract_abs(b.digits,a.digits))
            _ -> big(a.negative,subtract_abs(a.digits,b.digits))
big_sub = |a,b| big_add(a,big(!b.negative,b.digits))
multiply_digits = |digits,factor,index,carry,output|
    if index >= List.len(digits) then
        if carry == 0 then output else
            multiply_digits(digits,factor,index,carry//Num.to_u128(base),List.append(output,Num.to_u64(carry%Num.to_u128(base))))
    else
        product = Num.to_u128(get(digits,index))*Num.to_u128(factor)+carry
        digit = Num.to_u64(product%Num.to_u128(base))
        multiply_digits(digits,factor,index+1,product//Num.to_u128(base),List.append(output,digit))
big_mul = |a,factor| big(a.negative,multiply_digits(a.digits,factor,0,0u128,List.with_capacity(List.len(a.digits)+2)))
bit_length = |digits|
    if List.is_empty(digits) then 0u64 else
        top = get(digits,List.len(digits)-1)
        (List.len(digits)-1)*32+64-Num.to_u64(Num.count_leading_zero_bits(top))
shift_bits = |digits,bits|
    scale = Num.shift_left_by(1u64,Num.to_u8(bits%32))
    multiplied = big_mul(big(Bool.false,digits),scale)
    List.concat(List.repeat(0u64,bits//32),multiplied.digits)
power_bit = |bits| List.append(List.repeat(0u64,bits//32),Num.shift_left_by(1u64,Num.to_u8(bits%32)))
divide_abs = |remainder,divisor,quotient|
    if compare_abs(remainder,divisor) == LT then (quotient,remainder) else
        difference = bit_length(remainder)-bit_length(divisor)
        candidate = shift_bits(divisor,difference)
        bits = if compare_abs(candidate,remainder) == GT then difference-1 else difference
        scaled = if bits == difference then candidate else shift_bits(divisor,bits)
        next = subtract_abs(remainder,scaled)
        updated = add_abs(quotient,power_bit(bits))
        divide_abs(next,divisor,updated)
big_floor : Big, Big -> Big
big_floor = |a,b|
    if List.is_empty(b.digits) then crash("division by zero") else
        (quotient,remainder) = divide_abs(a.digits,b.digits,[])
        negative = a.negative != b.negative
        rounded = if negative && !List.is_empty(remainder) then add_abs(quotient,[1u64]) else quotient
        big(negative,rounded)
extract = |factor,q,r,t| big_floor(big_add(big_mul(q,factor),r),t)
spigot = |n,produced,k,q,r,t,pending,rows|
    if produced == n then Str.join_with(rows,"") else
        first = extract(3,q,r,t)
        second = extract(4,q,r,t)
        if first == second then
            digit = List.first(first.digits) ?? 0
            count = produced+1
            line = Str.concat(pending,Num.to_str(digit))
            complete = count%10 == 0 || count == n
            next_rows = if complete then
                padding = Str.repeat(" ",10-Str.count_utf8_bytes(line))
                List.append(rows,"${line}${padding}\t:${Num.to_str(count)}\n")
            else rows
            next_pending = if complete then "" else line
            next_r = big_mul(big_sub(r,big_mul(t,digit)),10)
            next_q = big_mul(q,10)
            spigot(n,count,k,next_q,next_r,t,next_pending,next_rows)
        else
            next_k = k+1
            multiplier = 2*next_k+1
            next_r = big_mul(big_add(r,big_mul(q,2)),multiplier)
            next_q = big_mul(q,next_k)
            next_t = big_mul(t,multiplier)
            spigot(n,produced,next_k,next_q,next_r,next_t,pending,rows)
main! : List Arg => Result {} _
main! = |args|
    Stdout.write!(spigot(argument(args),0,0,natural(1),natural(0),natural(1),"",[]))

            mul_ui(q,q,u64(k))

    call mpz_init_set_ui(num, 1_c_long)

        d = extract_digit(3_c_long)

        call mpz_mul_ui(acc, acc, 10_c_long)
        call mpz_mul_ui(num, num, 10_c_long)

from sys import argv

# quite correct for the __gmpz_get_ui() function which returns an unsigned long
# instead so we tell it the correct type here.
GMP.__gmpz_get_ui.restype=c_ulong


class mpz_t(Structure):
    _fields_=[("mp_alloc", c_int),
              ("mp_size", c_int),
              ("mp_d", c_void_p)]

tmp2=mpz_t()
acc=mpz_t()
den=mpz_t()
num=mpz_t()


def extract_Digit(nth):
    # Joggling between tmp1 and tmp2, so GMP won't have to use temp buffers.
    GMP.__gmpz_mul_ui(byref(tmp1), byref(num), c_ulong(nth))
    GMP.__gmpz_add(byref(tmp2), byref(tmp1), byref(acc))
    GMP.__gmpz_tdiv_q(byref(tmp1), byref(tmp2), byref(den))

    GMP.__gmpz_mul_ui(byref(den), byref(den), c_ulong(k2))
    GMP.__gmpz_mul_ui(byref(num), byref(num), c_ulong(k))

    GMP.__gmpz_init_set_ui(byref(tmp2), c_ulong(0))

# import a few functions from GMP wrapper to do in-place operations
using Base.GMP.MPZ: add_ui!, mul_ui!, add!, tdiv_q!
# and add a few more wrappers for GMP functions not currently in Base
const mpz_t = Ref{BigInt}
addmul_ui!(x::BigInt,a::BigInt,b) = ccall((:__gmpz_addmul_ui,"libgmp"), Cvoid, (mpz_t,mpz_t,Culong), x, a, b)
submul_ui!(x::BigInt,a::BigInt,b) = ccall((:__gmpz_submul_ui,"libgmp"), Cvoid, (mpz_t,mpz_t,Culong), x, a, b)
get_ui(x::BigInt) = ccall((:__gmpz_get_ui,"libgmp"), Culong, (mpz_t,), x)

function next!(q,r,t,k)
    mult  = 2*k + 1
    addmul_ui!(r,q,2)
    mul_ui!(r,mult)
    mul_ui!(t,mult)
    mul_ui!(q,k)
    return nothing
end

function extract!(q,r,t,tmp1,tmp2,n)
    mul_ui!(tmp1,q,n)
    add!(tmp1,r)
    tdiv_q!(tmp2,tmp1,t)
    return get_ui(tmp2)
end

function produce!(q,r,t,n)
    mul_ui!(q,10)
    submul_ui!(r,t,n)
    mul_ui!(r,10)
    return nothing
end

function pidigits(n::Int)
    q,r,t,tmp1,tmp2 = map(BigInt,(1,0,1,0,0))
    k = UInt(0)
    n_digits=0

    while n_digits<n
        i=0
        while (i<10 && n_digits<n)
            k +=1
            next!(q,r,t,k)
            q>r && continue

            digit = extract!(q,r,t,tmp1,tmp2,3)
            if digit == extract!(q,r,t,tmp1,tmp2,4)
                print(digit)
                produce!(q,r,t,digit)
                i +=1
                n_digits+=1
            end
        end
        while i < 10
            i+=1
            print(' ')
        end
        print("\t:$n_digits\n")
    end
end

pidigits(n)

         (for-syntax racket/base)

(define libgmp (ffi-lib "/opt/homebrew/opt/gmp/lib/libgmp.10.dylib"))
(define-syntax-rule (defgmp op type ...)
  (define op (get-ffi-obj (format "__gmpz_~a" 'op) libgmp (_fun type ...))))
(define-cstruct _mpz ([alloc _int] [size _int] [limbs _pointer]))
(defgmp init_set_ui _mpz-pointer _ulong -> _void)
(defgmp set_ui _mpz-pointer _ulong -> _void)
(defgmp get_ui    _mpz-pointer -> _ulong)
(defgmp add       _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer -> _void)
(defgmp mul       _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer -> _void)
(defgmp mul_ui    _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer _long        -> _void)
(defgmp addmul    _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer -> _void)
(defgmp addmul_ui _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer _ulong       -> _void)
(defgmp submul_ui _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer _ulong       -> _void)
(defgmp fdiv_q    _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer -> _void)
(defgmp cmp       _mpz-pointer _mpz-pointer              -> _int)
(define (make-ui n) (let ([i (make-mpz 0 0 #f)]) (init_set_ui i n) i))
;; "fancy" parser, for fun (only for the limited subset we use)
(define-syntax (gmp stx)
  (define (sym=? x y)
    (eq? (if (syntax? x) (syntax-e x) x) (if (syntax? y) (syntax-e y) y)))
  (define (_? stx)
    (and (identifier? stx)
         (regexp-match? #rx"^_" (symbol->string (syntax-e stx)))))
  (define (split xs)
    (let loop ([xs xs] [cur '()] [r '()])
      (define (add) (cons (reverse cur) r))
      (cond [(null? xs) (reverse (add))]
            [(syntax-case (car xs) (unquote) [,x #'x] [else #f])
             => (lambda (x) (loop (cdr xs) (list x) (add)))]
            [else (loop (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) cur) r)])))
  (define (translate expr)
    (syntax-case* expr (= += -= + * / < >) sym=?
      [(x = y + z)  #'(add x y z)]
      [(x = y * z)  #`(#,(if (_? #'z) #'mul #'mul_ui) x y z)]
      [(x += y * z) #`(#,(if (_? #'z) #'addmul #'addmul_ui) x y z)]
      [(x -= y * z) #`(#,(if (_? #'z) #'submul #'submul_ui) x y z)]
      [(x = y / z)  #'(fdiv_q x y z)]
      [(x < y)      #'(< (cmp x y) 0)]
      [(x > y)      #'(> (cmp x y) 0)]
      [(get x)      #'(get_ui x)]))
  (syntax-case stx ()
    [(_ x ...) #`(begin #,@(map translate (split (syntax->list #'(x ...)))))]))

;; the actual code

(define (digits n)
  (define i 0)
  (define _x0 (make-ui 1))
  (define _x1 (make-ui 0))
  (define _x2 (make-ui 1))
  (define _r  (make-ui 0))

  (define (extract-digit n)
    (gmp _r = _x0 * n, _r = _r + _x1, _r = _r / _x2, get _r))

  (let loop ([k 0])

    (define-syntax-rule (compose1!+loop)
      (let* ([k (add1 k)] [y2 (add1 (* k 2))])
        (gmp _x1 = _x1 * y2, _x1 += _x0 * (* y2 2), _x0 = _x0 * k,_x2 = _x2 * y2)
        (loop k)))
    (define-syntax-rule (compose2! d)
      (begin (gmp _x1 -= _x2 * d, _x1 = _x1 * 10, _x0 = _x0 * 10)
             (loop k)))

    (let ([d (extract-digit 3)])
        (if (not (= d (extract-digit 4)))
          (compose1!+loop)
          (begin (display d)
                 (set! i (add1 i))
                 (let ([m (modulo i 10)])
                   (when (zero? m) (printf "\t:~a\n" i))
                   (if (< i n)
                     (compose2! d)
                     (unless (zero? m)
                       (printf "~a\t:~a\n"
                               (make-string (- 10 m) #\space)
                               n)))))))))

(digits (command-line #:args (n) (string->number n)))

  (quotient (+ (* q x) r) (+ (* s x) t)))

(define (comp q r s t  q2 r2 s2 t2)
  (values (+ (* q q2) (* r s2))
          (+ (* q r2) (* r t2))
          (+ (* s q2) (* t s2))
          (+ (* s r2) (* t t2))))

(define (safe? q r s t n) (= n (floor_ev q r s t 4)))
(define (prod q r s t n) (comp 10 (* -10 n) 0 1  q r s t))
(define (mk q r s t k) (comp q r s t k (* 2 (add1 (* 2 k))) 0 (add1 (* 2 k))))

(define (digit k  q r s t  n row col)
  (if (> n 0)
      (let ([y (next q r s t)])
        (if (safe? q r s t y)
            (let-values ([(q r s t) (prod q r s t y)])
              (if (= col 10)
                  (let ([row (+ row 10)])
                    (printf "\t:~a\n~a" row y)
                    (digit k q r s t (sub1 n) row 1))
                  (begin
                    (printf "~a" y)
                    (digit k q r s t (sub1 n) row (add1 col)))))
            (let-values ([(q r s t) (mk q r s t k)])
              (digit (add1 k) q r s t n row col))))
      (printf "~a\t:~a\n"
              (make-string (- 10 col) #\space)
              (+ row col))))

  (digit 1  1 0 0 1  n 0 0))

import Platform
import Integer as I
port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
z n = I.fromSafeInt n
extract a q r t =
    I.divBy t (I.add (I.mul q (z a)) r) |> Maybe.withDefault (z 0)
spigot n produced k q r t pending rows =
    if produced == n then String.concat(List.reverse rows) else
        let
            first = extract 3 q r t
            second = extract 4 q r t
        in
        if I.compare first second == EQ then
            let
                digit = I.toInt first
                count = produced+1
                line = pending++String.fromInt digit
                complete = modBy 10 count == 0 || count == n
                nextRows = if complete then (String.padRight 10 ' ' line++"\t:"++String.fromInt count++"\n")::rows else rows
                nextPending = if complete then "" else line
                nextR = I.mul (I.sub r (I.mul t (z digit))) (z 10)
                nextQ = I.mul q (z 10)
            in
            spigot n count k nextQ nextR t nextPending nextRows
        else
            let
                nextK = k+1
                multiplier = z(2*nextK+1)
                nextR = I.mul (I.add r (I.mul q (z 2))) multiplier
                nextQ = I.mul q (z nextK)
                nextT = I.mul t multiplier
            in
            spigot n produced nextK nextQ nextR nextT pending rows

# contributed by Brad Chamberlain
# based on the Chapel #2 version and Python (#1) version

using Printf

function pidigits(numDigits::Int)
    numer,accum,denom,tmp1,tmp2 = map(BigInt,(1,0,1,0,0))

    i = k = 1
    ns = d = d2 = 0

    while i <= numDigits
        (accum,numer,denom) = nextTerm(k,accum,numer,denom)
        k += 1
        if numer <= accum
            (d,tmp1,tmp2) = extractDigit(3,numer,accum,denom,tmp1,tmp2)
            (d2,tmp1,tmp2) = extractDigit(4,numer,accum,denom,tmp1,tmp2)
            if d == d2
                ns = ns * 10 + d
                if i % 10 == 0
                    @printf("%010d\t:%d\n",ns,i)
                    ns = 0
                end
 
                (accum,numer) = eliminateDigit(d,accum,denom,numer)
                i += 1
            end
        end
    end

    # Pad out any trailing digits for the final line
    if numDigits % 10 != 0
        @printf("%s",lpad(ns,numDigits%10,"0"))
        for i in 1:(10-numDigits%10)
            @printf(" ")
        end
        @printf("\t:%d\n",n)
     end
end

function nextTerm(k::Int64, accum::BigInt, numer::BigInt, denom::BigInt)
    k2 = 2 * k + 1

    accum += numer*2
    accum *= k2
    denom *= k2
    numer *= k
    (accum,numer,denom)
end

function extractDigit(nth::Int64, numer::BigInt, accum::BigInt, denom::BigInt, tmp1::BigInt, tmp2::BigInt)
    tmp1 = numer * nth
    tmp2 = tmp1 + accum
    (tmp1,_) = divrem(tmp2,denom)

    (convert(Int64,tmp1),tmp1,tmp2)
end

function eliminateDigit(d::Int64, accum::BigInt, denom::BigInt, numer::BigInt)
    accum -= denom * d
    accum *= 10
    numer *= 10
    (accum,numer)
end

n = parse(Int,ARGS[1])
pidigits(n)
